HARP-USAMO-2010-5.bio: Investigate a series involving a specific calculation and its relationship with primes. Your algebraic skills will need to shine for this duel.

HARP-USAMO-2011-1.name: Algebraic Balancing
HARP-USAMO-2011-1.bio: Join me in unraveling the bounds of positive reals, proving that certain expressions achieve a harmonious balance.

HARP-USAMO-2011-5.name: Parallel Consequences
HARP-USAMO-2011-5.bio: Can you prove the conditions under which a segment within a quadrilateral remains parallel to its sides? Engage your geometric reasoning to uncover the truth.

HARP-USAMO-2011-6.name: Subset Union Size
HARP-USAMO-2011-6.bio: Venture into the world of set intersections and unions as you prove a lower bound for the union of multiple subsets of a given set. Challenge yourself with this intriguing relation.

HARP-USAMO-2012-2.name: Colorful Triangles
HARP-USAMO-2012-2.bio: Select points of various colors on a circle to create congruent triangles. Will your skills in combinatorics and symmetry allow this feat to succeed?

HARP-USAMO-2012-3.name: Infinite Integer Sequences
HARP-USAMO-2012-3.bio: I challenge you to determine the integers n greater than 1 for which an infinite sequence of nonzero integers satisfies a particular summation equality. The quest for sequences begins.

HARP-USAMO-2012-5.name: Collinear Reflections
HARP-USAMO-2012-5.bio: Demonstrate the collinearity of points derived from reflections across a line within a triangle. Your understanding of reflections and geometry will be key.

HARP-USAMO-2013-1.name: Circumcircle Connections
HARP-USAMO-2013-1.bio: Engage in a triangular duel that connects circumcircles and secants, revealing ratios that beckon proof.

HARP-USAMO-2013-2.name: Circle of Moves
HARP-USAMO-2013-2.bio: I challenge you to count the distinct ways to advance around a circle without retracing steps. It takes creativity and keen observation to navigate my pathways.

HARP-USAMO-2013-6.name: Triangle Tangents
HARP-USAMO-2013-6.bio: I challenge you to find points on segment BC such that a special relationship holds involving distances from point P to both the triangle's circumcircles and segment lengths.

HARP-USAMO-2014-3.name: Collinear Points
HARP-USAMO-2014-3.bio: Explore a world where distinct integers dictate the alignment of points in the plane; prove that these points can be endlessly created as long as they meet a certain sum requirement.

HARP-USAMO-2014-6.name: GCD Bound
HARP-USAMO-2014-6.bio: Face the challenge where you must demonstrate that a specific relationship between positive integers holds, governed by the greatest common divisor over a range.

HARP-USAMO-2015-1.name: Cubical Conundrum
HARP-USAMO-2015-1.bio: Unravel the integer solutions to an enigmatic cubic equation, where the interplay of variables takes center stage.

HARP-USAMO-2015-3.name: Subset Colorings
HARP-USAMO-2015-3.bio: Venture into the realm of colored subsets and unravel the mystery behind the product of blue counts, all hinging on the interplay of union and intersection.

HARP-USAMO-2016-1.name: Subset Sequence Challenge
HARP-USAMO-2016-1.bio: Enter the realm of distinct subsets, navigating through disjointness and union conditions in a mystical set.

HARP-USAMO-2016-3.name: Perpendicular Lines
HARP-USAMO-2016-3.bio: Prove that under certain geometric constructions within an acute triangle, crucial lines will intersect at right angles, revealing hidden relationships.

HARP-USAMO-2017-1.name: Relatively Prime Pairs
HARP-USAMO-2017-1.bio: Prove the infinite existence of unique pairs of integers whose sum weaves a thread through divisibility.

HARP-USAMO-2018-1.name: Cubic Harmony
HARP-USAMO-2018-1.bio: Dive into the elegant equality of positive reals, where a delicate balance in squares and products must be proven.

HARP-USAMO-2018-2.name: Function Equation
HARP-USAMO-2018-2.bio: I present a curious relationship involving functions defined on positive reals. To conquer me, you must delve into the intricacies of functional equations.

HARP-USAMO-2018-5.name: Cyclic Quadrilateral Angles
HARP-USAMO-2018-5.bio: Within a convex cyclic quadrilateral, I reveal a mysterious angle property tied to intersecting lines. Embrace your geometric intuition to unveil my secrets.

HARP-USAMO-2018-6.name: Odd Permutations
HARP-USAMO-2018-6.bio: Delve into the world of permutations and demonstrate that a specific count of arrangements defies evenness, no matter the size—an oddity indeed.

HARP-USAMO-2019-2.name: Bisecting Points
HARP-USAMO-2019-2.bio: In the realm of cyclic quadrilaterals, I guard a unique property related to bisecting lines within. Gear up to apply angle chasing to unlock my truth.

HARP-USAMO-2019-3.name: Polynomials in K
HARP-USAMO-2019-3.bio: Join me in identifying all polynomials that yield only integers free of the digit 7 in their representation, based on a select set of integers.

HARP-USAMO-2019-4.name: Set Selection Scheme
HARP-USAMO-2019-4.bio: Discover the layered selection of sets in a grid, facing the rules of containment and cardinality.

HARP-USAMO-2019-5.name: Rational Means
HARP-USAMO-2019-5.bio: I set forth a challenge involving rational numbers and their means. Only those with number-theoretic prowess can discover the pairs that lead to unity.

HARP-USAMO-2019-6.name: Real Coefficient Polynomials
HARP-USAMO-2019-6.bio: Engage in finding polynomials that balance complex relationships involving nonzero real numbers, adhering to a particular condition.

HARP-USAMO-2020-1.name: Triangle Area Mystery
HARP-USAMO-2020-1.bio: Join me on a quest to minimize area in a realm of acute triangles, where angles and pivot points are key.

HARP-USAMO-2021-6.name: Collinear Centers
HARP-USAMO-2021-6.bio: Demonstrate the intriguing collinearity of centers related to a hexagon with parallel sides and certain geometric constructions, revealing deeper connections.

HARP-USAMO-2022-1.name: Grid Colors
HARP-USAMO-2022-1.bio: I challenge you to prove that amidst a grid of amber and bronze cells, you can select a specific number of each without sharing rows or columns.

HARP-USAMO-2022-4.name: Prime Squares
HARP-USAMO-2022-4.bio: Find the pairs of primes where the differences and products create perfect squares, and show your mastery of number theory.

HARP-USAMO-2023-6.name: Angles and Intersections
HARP-USAMO-2023-6.bio: Test your geometric skills by proving a fascinating angle condition involving a triangle's incenter and excenters with respect to specific intersection points.
